subject: language
intro: Ms. Alvarez here. Let's plan a narrative writing lesson focused on story structure.

beats.narration: The story mountain is the visual organizer for the whole unit.
This standard asks students to write narratives with well-structured event sequences.
Today is planning; drafting comes tomorrow.
beats.text: Students will be able to plan a personal narrative using a story mountain with a clear beginning, rising action, climax, and resolution.

beats.narration: The quick-write generates story ideas they can use.
beats.text: Quick-write: "Write about a time something didn't go as planned." 5 minutes, no stopping.

beats.narration: Plotting my own story shows vulnerability and a real model.
beats.text: Model plotting a story mountain from a short mentor text, then plot one of my own stories live. Show how the climax is the moment of highest tension.

beats.narration: Telling it aloud reveals gaps before they write.
beats.text: Students plot their quick-write story on a story mountain, then tell it aloud to a partner, who identifies the climax.

beats.narration: The planning document becomes the check.
beats.text: Turn in your story mountain with each section filled in and your climax starred.

outro: Quick-write, model, plan, share. Now you plan.
